title: EventCatalogEntry
description: Schema for a single event catalog entry in the Fabric_4L Event Catalog.

event_type.description: Canonical event type identifier, e.g. billing.subscription.activated.v1

owner.description: Team or bounded context that owns semantics and emission, e.g. layer7-billing/subscriptions

producer.description: Service path that emits the canonical event, e.g. services/layer7-billing

triggered_by.description: Commands, state transitions, or observations that trigger this event

schema_ref.description: Reference to the payload schema, e.g. jsonschema://billing/events/subscription-activated@1.1.0

envelope_ref.description: Reference to the event envelope schema, e.g. jsonschema://common/event-envelope@1.0.0

subject_type.description: Primary entity type the event is about, e.g. subscription

tenant_scope.description: Scoping of the event within the tenant hierarchy

partition_key.description: Field used for stream/topic partitioning, e.g. billing_account_id

consumer_effect_key.description: Stable key consumers use for idempotency, e.g. event.id

expected_latency_ms.description: Expected end-to-end publication latency in milliseconds

criticality.description: Operational criticality for alerting and SLO

status.description: Lifecycle status of the event definition

sensitive_payload.description: Whether the payload contains PII or other sensitive data

transport_channel.description: Topic, queue, or stream name, e.g. billing.events

deprecation_notice.description: Migration guidance when status is DEPRECATED or SUNSET

supersedes.description: Event type that this event supersedes, if any

preconditions.description: Business preconditions that must hold for the event to be emitted

postconditions.description: Business postconditions guaranteed after the event is emitted
